attestations.text: FIYANGGÛ 費揚古(武)，1645–1701, Sept., general, was a member of the Donggo clan. His elder sister, Empress Hsiao-hsien [q. v.], was the favorite secondary consort of Emperor Shih-tsu. For her sake the emperor in 1657 raised the hereditary rank of their father, Oši (see under Hsiao-hsien), a veteran of many wars, to earl of the third class.
費揚古，棟鄂氏，滿洲正白旗人，內大臣三等伯鄂碩子。
